svg.text: Samsung Galaxy S8 (SM-G950N / Exynos 8895) — Native Linux 4.4.111 Kernel & System Architecture
Pure Linux Initramfs (switch_root -> PID 1 systemd) | DEFEX Stripped | Unmodified Upstream OS + galaxy-s8-hw Pack
1. VERIFIED BOOT CHAIN, ODIN AP SLOTS & FAIL-SAFE SWITCH_ROOT ARCHITECTURE
TWRP 3.7.0 + root ADB for S8 Imager flashing
LED Signal: Blue (0x0000FF) -> Green (0x00FF00) on boot
BusyBox telnetd recovery shell on TCP port 2323
2. LINUX 4.4.111 KERNEL & EXYNOS 8895 SILICON CAPABILITY MATRIX (VERIFIED FROM kernel/.config & HARDWARE)
4 GB LPDDR4x (~3.6 GB usable) + 2 GB ZRAM LZ4 (ZRAM=y)
64 GB UFS 2.1 (sda24 53.7 GB ext4 ^extents) + MMC_DW mmcblk0
PREEMPT=y | ARM64_VA_BITS=39 | EXT4 / F2FS / FUSE / VFAT
SECURITY_DEFEX is not set (allows glibc 2.39 binaries)
RKP_CFP is not set (EL2 hypervisor cold-boot safe)
Display, Audio, PMIC Power & Physical I/O
Strips /dev/video100+ at boot/udev to prevent NULL querycap panic
9 RAM DSP blobs | MAX98506 SPK (hw:0,0) | CS47L92 Mic (hw:0,9)
Power: Hold >=2.5s Off | 2x Reboot | Short DPMS | Bixby Actions
Shannon 359 LTE (umts_ipc0 / rmnet0..7) | Torch, Haptic, USB HID
3. MODULAR GALAXY-S8-HW PACKAGE SERVICES & VERIFIED ACCESS CHANNELS
galaxy-s8-hw (v1.0.0) Runtime Layer — Debian .deb & Universal .tar.gz (+ OpenRC)
PMIC 1500mA, V4L2 guard, ZRAM, ABOX ALSA, BCM4361
ConfigFS USB RNDIS NIC (192.168.7.2) + DHCP server
s8_typec_daemon.py DFP host/source Alt Mode monitor
BCM4361 BT firmware upload & HCI bring-up
RGB status heartbeat & thermal/battery telemetry cues
s8-time-sync.py NTP + HTTP Date drift recovery
CPU/GPU clocks, torch, haptic, Wi-Fi scan/connect, audio
Wired USB RNDIS Ethernet (Works Without Wi-Fi)
Configure via S8 Imager Config -> SCAN -> APPLY | ssh <user>@<wifi-ip>
Direct USB-C DisplayPort Monitor + HID Input
USB-C Hub -> 1080p60 HDMI/DP via fb2 | Zero vendor CONFIG_VT dependency
Auto-selects TWRP ADB for OS flashing & RNDIS/Wi-Fi RWP SSH for Linux OS
